Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and practically to installers and non-technical stakeholders. Nice-to-Haves F-Gas Category 1 certification. Knowledge and practical experience of R290 refrigerant systems and associated safety requirements. Hands-on experience with DNO applications, including G98/G99, and the Boiler Upgrade Scheme (BUS) process. Experience supporting MCS-certified heat pump projects from design through installation and commissioning. Knowledge of smart heating controls, including weather compensation. Familiarity with energy optimisation and smart-tariff integration, including systems designed to work with Octopus Energy dynamic tariffs. Previous experience providing technical training to installers or developing an installer network.
